name: key_metadata
command: for d in /var/dropbear /tmp/dropbear /data/dropbear /data/config /data/etc; do ls -ld "$d" 2>/dev/null; done; for p in /var/dropbear/* /tmp/dropbear/* /data/dropbear/*; do [ -e "$p" ] && ls -ld "$p"; done; ls -ld /etc/shells /bin/sh; [ ! -f /etc/shells ] || cat /etc/shells

name: sockets
command: netstat -lnt 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR<3 || $4 ~ /:(22|23)$/'; ip -o -4 addr show br0 2>/dev/null; ip -o link show 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$2}'

name: flash_geometry
command: for d in /sys/class/mtd/mtd[0-9]*; do printf '%s ' "${d##*/}"; for f in name type size erasesize writesize oobsize offset flags; do [ ! -r "$d/$f" ] || { printf '%s=' "$f"; tr '\n' ' ' < "$d/$f"; }; done; printf '\n'; done
